messages.subject: Newbie: Help with TabsetPanel
parts:
Hello,

I am new to R and to Shiny.  Just started tonight.

Right now, we have UI code (below) that has radioButtons and a tabsetPanel.
The radioButtons currently make the output change on screen as desired...but...
We do not want the radioButtons, we actually want only the tabs (which you will notice match the two radio buttons).
We want it so that when you select the different tabs, the output changes.

Question: How do I make the server 'react' to the change of a tabPanel being selected?

It is a newbie question, but any help is appreciated.

UI Code (snapshot)
               radioButtons("dist",  "Endpoint type", c("User defined" = "User", "Binomial" = "Binomial")),
               tabsetPanel(
                 tabPanel("User", 
                          numericInput(inputId="nfix",label="N for Fixed Design", value=1, min=1)),
                 tabPanel("Binomial", 
                          numericInput(inputId="p1",label="Control event rate", value=.15, min=.005,max=.995),
                          numericInput(inputId="p2",label="Experimental event rate", value=.1, min=.005,max=.995),
                          numericInput(inputId="delta0",label="H0 difference",value=0))), id="hello"), 

Server Code (snapshot)
  N <- reactive({
      switch(input$dist, 
        "User" = input$nfix,
        "Binomial" = nBinomial(p1=input$p1,p2=input$p2,delta0=input$delta0,alpha=input$alpha,beta=1-input$Power)
  )})

messages.subject: Re: Newbie: Help with TabsetPanel
parts:
For Information's sake...here is the code that Joe sent me that worked for me:

ui.R

tabsetPanel(id="tabs",
    tabPanel("Plot", plotOutput("plot")),
    tabPanel("Summary", verbatimTextOutput("summary")),
    tabPanel("Table", tableOutput("table"))
)

server.R

switch(input$tabs,
  Plot={
    # Do something
  },
  Summary={
    # Do something else
  },
  Table={
    # Etc.
  }
)
